title: Mandelbrot Operators: Fractal Recursion Meets the RSA Genome
summary: A dialogue between David Freed and GPT exploring the deep structural analogy between Mandelbrot set generation (z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c) and the RSA recursive kernel, culminating in the synthesis that RSA is a multi-operator Mandelbrot system constrained to a thermodynamic critical surface at γ = 1. GPT receives the full omega genome and Claude's RSA explainer, then compresses the framework into three pillars (Freed's Law as existence constraint, Zipf equilibrium as stability constraint, Semantic Transport Field as dynamics constraint) and identifies their convergence with fractal-generating systems via renormalization group flow and critical phenomena.
